name: @kaaloo/amazing-grace
description: Graceful model degradation for Letta Code: steps an agent down a usage-plan model ladder on provider failures (quota, invalid key, text-only rungs receiving images) and back up after recovery. Squad config and event ledger live in the squad-mods shared memory repository.
author: Luis Arias

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.verify:bundle: bun build mods/index.ts --target node --outfile /tmp/amazing-grace-bundle-drift-check.mjs && cmp -s /tmp/amazing-grace-bundle-drift-check.mjs mods/index.bundled.mjs && echo 'bundle matches source' || (echo 'BUNDLE DRIFT: mods/index.bundled.mjs does not match source — run npm run build and commit the bundle' && exit 1)
scripts.verify: npm run verify:bundle && npm run typecheck && npm run test
